text_block_list.text:
...Ehehe, races really do make me nervous. 
My heart's been pounding like crazy since 
this morning.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Still, winning will bring me one step 
closer to becoming Japan's best horse 
girl. Thinking about that makes me kind of 
look forward to it.
choice_data_list: Go give it everything you've got!
